name: Module reorder requires remove and include in an authorized transaction

input.source_text: module Mo { public fun h() -> Integer { 1 } } module Mp { public fun h() -> Integer { 2 } } class A mixin Mo, Mp { } module M { public fun run() -> Object { let before = A.new().h(); A.remove_module(Mo); let mid = A.new().h(); A.add_module(Mo); [before, mid, A.new().h(), A.modules.length()] } } M.run()

applicability.reason: Module edge reorder has no native boundary.
